observation.command:
export RABBITMQ_NODENAME=rabbit@localhost RABBITMQ_NODE_IP_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1
# Create xplanbox user per guide
rabbitmqctl add_user xplanbox xplanbox 2>&1
rabbitmqctl set_user_tags xplanbox administrator 2>&1
rabbitmqctl set_permissions -p / xplanbox ".*" ".*" ".*" 2>&1
# Set consumer-timeout and delivery-limit policies for quorum queues per guide
rabbitmqctl set_policy xplanbox-consumer-timeout --apply-to queues ".*" '{"consumer-timeout":"3000000","delivery-limit":1}' 2>&1
echo "=== users ==="
rabbitmqctl list_users 2>&1
echo "=== policies ==="
rabbitmqctl list_policies 2>&1
